Affiliate Disclosure & Editorial Policy

Last updated: September 2026

1. Overview

At IbadanSolarHub.com.ng, our mission is to provide accurate, transparent, and actionable renewable energy information to homeowners, business managers, and technicians across Nigeria. We believe in complete transparency regarding how our platform is funded.

2. Affiliate Relationships

IbadanSolarHub.com.ng participates in various affiliate marketing programs designed to provide a means for websites to earn advertising fees by linking to retail partners. These include, but are not limited to:

  • Jumia KOL / Affiliate Program (Jumia Nigeria)
  • Konga Affiliate Program
  • Direct verified Nigerian solar distributor partner programs
  • International equipment suppliers

When you click on links pointing to these retailers and complete a qualifying purchase, we may receive a small affiliate commission at absolutely zero additional cost to you. In fact, our negotiated partnerships frequently provide exclusive discounts for our community.

3. Editorial Independence

Our technical reviews, battery cycle comparisons, inverter sizing recommendations, and installer evaluations are based solely on engineering merit, durability under Nigerian environmental conditions, and real-world customer satisfaction. We do not accept payment to give artificially positive ratings to defective or counterfeit hardware.

4. Display Advertising

We may display banner advertisements served by third-party advertising networks (such as Google AdSense) or direct private sponsors. Sponsored placements are clearly marked with labels such as "Advertisement", "Sponsored", or "Partner Spotlight".

5. Contact Us

If you have any questions or feedback regarding our affiliate relationships or disclosures, please contact us at info@ibadansolarhub.com.ng.
